description: Procurement and supply of Motorized Electric Tricycles for differently abled persons under the Untied Fund of Taluk Panchayat, Basavana Bagewadi, Vijayapura District. The tricycles shall be motorized electric-operated vehicles designed for mobility assistance to physically challenged beneficiaries, including standard safety features, rechargeable battery system, charger, and necessary accessories as per government-approved specifications.
